text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O and I gear up to
challenge the
big race at the end of the
year, the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"A sakura's blossoms may scatter in
spring, but
deep down, its roots are
always growing!" Who'd
have thought I'd
be able to run in a long-distance
race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Trainer, did you know there's
something
special about me running in
the Arima?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, wait! So you didn't sign me up with
that in
mind? If this is all a happy
coincidence, maybe it
should stay as my
little secret.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I was just kidding. I'll tell you.
choice_data_list: え、教えてくれないのか？
choice_data_list_en: Wait, you're not gonna tell me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is one of the races
Maruzen
wasn't able to run in.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: There was an article about a Umamusume who did run it, though. They called her "a miracle fast enough to rival Maruzensky."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Now I'm Maruzen's rival. Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: ああ。ライバルの強さを見せつけよう
うん。ライバルの強さを見せつけよう
choice_data_list_en: Yeah. Let's show them how formidable rivals can be.
Yeah. Let's show them just how tough your rival can be.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Why, welcome, dear rival of the Hot
Rod.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? C.B.?! You're running this race
too?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was so impressed by that
spectacular,
heart-stopping race you
two showed me before.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It seems it's not Maruzen I must run
against, but
you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm not the type to dance with
the
divine. I prefer to run down the earth
and make it
tremble.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm a free spirit who seeks to challenge
all those
who send a thrill through my
heart. Now... how
about you show me
what you've got?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gladly! Let's have a good race!
